method: Reviewed source builder and rendered HTML prose/tables in RU/EN/DE. Recomputed route-frequency scenario independently and matched reported metrics to verified summary. Locale-normalized numeric table values compared between all languages.

limits: Factual, numerical and methodological review; not a professional multilingual copy edit.
The frequency conversion is an illustrative 365-day uniform-year assumption with equal directions, not observed flight frequency or a route-launch recommendation.
No causal, truly unserved-route, monthly-seasonality or production P/T/F accuracy result is established.
Article remains a draft awaiting owner modelling and publication decision.
